_meta.description: Team metadata for World Cup 2026 prediction — coach experience, roster stability, chemistry. Manually curated. v2.0: expanded from 20→32 teams based on squad announcements.

scoring.coach_wc_experience: Number of World Cups coached (0-5). Each WC adds 8 ELO.
scoring.roster_stability: Fraction of players retained from last major tournament (0.0-1.0). Formula: (stability - 0.5) × 40
scoring.recent_form_consistency: Win rate in last 10 competitive matches. Formula: (consistency - 0.5) × 30

Spain._comment: De la Fuente — 1st WC. Yamal+Merino+Nico DOUBTFUL, Fermin OUT. Attacking depth crisis.

Argentina._comment: Scaloni — WC 2022 champion. Romero+Molina DOUBTFUL, Messi thigh overload (expected fit).

France._comment: Deschamps — WC 2022 finalist. Mbappe+Dembele lead. Squad confirmed. Ekitike OUT (Achilles).

England._comment: Tuchel — 1st WC. Foden+Palmer+TAA+White+Branthwaite+Grealish OUT. Massive injury crisis.

Brazil._comment: Ancelotti — 1st WC. Rodrygo+Militao+Estevao OUT, Neymar DOUBTFUL. Injury-hit but deep.

Portugal._comment: Roberto Martinez — WC 2018 (Belgium 3rd). Ronaldo set for record 6th WC. Squad confirmed.

Colombia._comment: Nestor Lorenzo — excellent form, dark horse. Strong CONMEBOL qualifiers.

Netherlands._comment: Koeman — 2nd WC. Simons+Schouten+de Ligt OUT, Timber DOUBTFUL. Defensive crisis.

Germany._comment: Nagelsmann — 1st WC. Gnabry OUT, ter Stegen OUT (backup GK, minimal impact). Neuer #1.

Morocco._comment: Walid Regragui — WC 2022 semifinalist. Strong team cohesion.

Japan._comment: Moriyasu — 2nd WC. Mitoma OUT (hamstring), Endo FIT. Minamino not selected.

United States._comment: Mauricio Pochettino — 1st WC. Host nation (60 ELO bonus). Inconsistent form.

Senegal._comment: Aliou Cisse — long-tenured. Mane in squad. AFCON 2021 winners. Squad announced.

Ecuador._comment: Felix Sanchez — strong CONMEBOL qualifiers. Dangerous dark horse.

Uruguay._comment: Marcelo Bielsa — 1st WC with Uruguay. Squad transition period.

Croatia._comment: Zlatko Dalic — WC 2018 finalist, 2022 semifinalist. Modric (40) in squad. Squad confirmed.

Belgium._comment: Rudi Garcia — new coach. Lukaku in squad ('out of shape'). Golden generation fading. Squad confirmed.

Mexico._comment: Javier Aguirre — host nation (60 ELO bonus). Preliminary squad announced.

Switzerland._comment: Murat Yakin — Xhaka makes 4th WC. Reliable tournament team. Squad confirmed.

Norway._comment: Stale Solbakken — 1st WC for Norway in 28 years. Haaland+Odegaard headline. Squad confirmed.

Sweden._comment: Jon Dahl Tomasson — Isak+Gyokeres named. Squad confirmed. Dangerous attack.

South Korea._comment: Hong Myung-bo — Son Heung-min (LA FC) captain for 4th WC. Kim Min-jae anchors defense. Squad confirmed.

Scotland._comment: Steve Clarke — 1st WC since 1998. Stewart & Curtis in squad. Squad confirmed.

Tunisia._comment: Sabri Lamouchi — Sassi left out. Squad confirmed. Consistent African qualifier.

Egypt._comment: Hossam Hassan — Salah FIT and named in squad (hamstring recovery complete). Marmoush also in. Squad confirmed.

Ivory Coast._comment: Emerse Fae — AFCON 2023 champions. Zaha OMITTED from squad. Squad confirmed.

New Zealand._comment: Darren Bazeley — Chris Wood leads. Braintree's Smith makes squad. Squad confirmed.

DR Congo._comment: Sebastien Desabre — Wan-Bissaka+Wissa in squad. Squad confirmed. Dangerous on counter.

Bosnia and Herzegovina._comment: Sergej Barbarez — Dzeko (40) joins WC's oldest players. Squad confirmed.

Haiti._comment: Jean-Jacques Pierre — Isidor+Bellegarde in squad. First WC since 1974.

Curacao._comment: Dean Gorre — Smallest nation at WC. Debut appearance. Squad confirmed.

Algeria._comment: Vladimir Petkovic — strong African qualifier. Experienced squad.

Austria._comment: Ralf Rangnick — high-pressing style. Competitive in Euro 2024 group of death.

Ghana._comment: Otto Addo — Kudus DOUBTFUL (quad, since Jan). Key player for Ghana's hopes.

Canada._comment: Marsch — 1st WC. Davies DOUBTFUL (hamstring, 'several weeks'). Tournament participation at risk.

Turkey._comment: Montella — 1st WC as coach. Euro 2024 quarterfinalist. Guler+Yildiz generation. First WC since 2002. Arda Guler DOUBTFUL (hamstring).

Australia._comment: Popovic — 1st WC. Miller OUT (Achilles). Consecutive WC appearances but squad rebuilding.

Czech Republic._comment: Miroslav Koubek — 1st WC. Named 54-man provisional May 12. Soucek+Schick lead.

Paraguay._comment: Gustavo Alfaro — 1st WC with Paraguay (coached Ecuador at 2022 WC). Defensive style.

South Africa._comment: Hugo Broos — 1st WC (but coached Cameroon at 2017 AFCON). Limited talent pool. ELO 1524.

Qatar._comment: Queiroz — 4th WC (Iran 2014/2018/2022). Host 2022 experience. Weakest ELO (1427) among 48 teams.

Iran._comment: Amir Ghalenoei — 1st WC as head coach. Taremi+Azmoun lead attack. Consistent AFC qualifier.

Iraq._comment: Jesus Casas — 1st WC. Spain-born coach. First WC since 1986. Young squad.

Saudi Arabia._comment: Hervé Renard — 2nd WC with Saudi (coached 2022, beat Argentina). Also coached Morocco 2018.

Jordan._comment: First-ever World Cup appearance. AFC Asian Cup 2023 runners-up. Massive underdog.

Uzbekistan._comment: Srecko Katanec — 1st WC as coach. First-ever World Cup appearance. Shomurodov key player.

Panama._comment: Thomas Christiansen — 1st WC as coach. Second WC appearance (debut 2018).
